description:
We are a creative and motivated team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are looking for serious, committed members who can actively contribute and bring their skills to the project.

We welcome people skilled in programming, AI, design, video editing, research, science, or presentation. Creativity, teamwork, reliability, and the ability to deliver high-quality work are what we value most.

If you're ready to work seriously, share ideas, and build something impactful, join us!
